extDescription.message: Learn a language from any video on the web: live subtitles, colour-matched translations and quizzes, with the AI of your choice.

noKeyWarning.message: Subtitles work without a key. Add one for translations and quizzes.

trModeBlur.message: The translation stays blurred until you hover over it.

trModeAlways.message: The translation is always shown under the line.

trModeClick.message: Click a line to see its translation.

trModeHelp.message: Blurred mode translates a line when you point at it (or every line, with Translate on hover off); always mode translates every line. Matching colours show which part means what. Lines you reveal in blurred mode go into your quiz.

targetLangHelp.message: The language spoken in the videos. Pick the accent closest to the video for better speech recognition.

apiKeyHelp.message: Stored only in this browser and sent only to the provider you picked. Each provider keeps its own key.

sourceAuto.message: Automatic: the site's subtitles, otherwise speech recognition

sourceHelp.message: The site's own subtitles are more accurate and have no delay; turn on subtitles in the language you're learning in the player (CC on YouTube). Speech recognition is for videos without subtitles.

quizMinutesHelp.message: Minutes of watching with speech. Paused or silent parts don't count.

sameLanguage.message: The language you're learning and your language must be different.

quizTitle.message: Quiz on what you just watched

noQuiz.message: No quiz yet. Watch something with captions on.

clickHint.message: Click for the translation and notes · drag to move

extensionReloaded.message: The extension was reloaded; refresh the page.

statusWaitingPage.message: Waiting for the site's subtitles (turn them on in the player)…

quizAlreadyRunning.message: A quiz is already being prepared.

quizNotEnough.message: Not enough speech for a quiz yet; keep watching.

speech_trackUnsupported.message: Speech recognition couldn't use the tab's audio. Update Chrome (recognising tab audio is required).

speech_noApi.message: This browser has no speech recognition (Web Speech API).

speech_captureFailed.message: Could not capture the tab's audio: $1

errNoKey.message: No API key. Add it in the extension settings.

errPermission.message: This API key can't use this model.

errRateLimit.message: Rate limited; try again in a moment.

errConnection.message: Could not reach the Anthropic API.

errTruncated.message: The response was cut off; try again.

errUnreadable.message: The model's response could not be read.

optionsSubtitle.message: Learn a language from any video. Changes are saved automatically.

secLanguagesHelp.message: Changes apply right away, even while subtitles are on.

nativeLangHelp.message: Translations and explanations are written in this language.

levelHelp.message: Sets how hard the quiz questions are.

summaryGreat.message: Great work, you followed it closely.

summaryGood.message: Good job. Check the explanations for the ones you missed.

summaryKeepGoing.message: Keep going. Rewatching a scene with the translation blurred helps a lot.

footerPrivacy.message: Your key stays in this browser

secProviderHelp.message: Translations and quizzes are made by this provider and billed to your key.

modelHelp.message: Leave empty to use $1. Load models to pick from your provider's current list.

modelsLoaded.message: $1 models found. Pick one from the list in the field.

errModel.message: Model not available: $1 Choose another model in Settings.

activitySubtitle.message: Your daily practice. Kept only in this browser.

noActivity.message: No activity yet. Start captions on a video and it will show up here.

subOff.message: Off. Switch on for this page.

subOnOther.message: On in another tab. Switching on moves it here.

subUnsupported.message: Kavra can't run on this page. Open a video site.

setupWarning.message: Set Kavra up in about a minute.

obWelcomeText.message: Kavra turns any video on the web into a language lesson. Setup takes about a minute.

obFeature1.message: Live subtitles on any site, from the site's own subtitles or from the audio.

obFeature2.message: Colour-matched translations you can blur, show or open with notes.

obFeature3.message: Quizzes on what you watched, and a daily activity history.

obLangText.message: Pick the language spoken in your videos and the language you want translations in.

obLevelText.message: Quiz questions are pitched at this level. You can change it later.

obAiText.message: Translations and quizzes are made by the provider you choose, with your own key. Subtitles work without one, so you can add it later.

obUse1.message: Pin Kavra: click the puzzle icon in Chrome's toolbar, then the pin next to Kavra.

obUse2.message: Open a video and turn on its subtitles in the language you're learning (CC on YouTube).

obUse3.message: Click the Kavra icon and switch Subtitles on.

obUse4.message: Click a line to pause and see its translation and notes. A quiz opens after the minutes you set.

obDoneText.message: Open a video and switch Kavra on. You can change everything later in Settings.

activityLabel.message: $1 minutes of practice over $2 active days

wrongLanguage.message: The audio sounds like $1, not $2. Pick the video's original audio to learn with it.

textSizeHelp.message: Smaller text leaves room for longer lines on the video.

historyHelp.message: A button by the subtitles lists the last 5 lines; point at one for its translation.

lazyHelp.message: In blur mode a line is translated only when you point at it. It uses far fewer tokens; the translation takes a moment to appear, and lines stay uncoloured until then.

quizResetNewVideo.message: New video: the quiz starts over.

wordsSubtitle.message: Lines you saved from the translation card, with their translations and notes.

wordsEmpty.message: Nothing saved yet. Click a subtitle line, then “+ Save to word pool” on its card.

wordsNoMatch.message: No saved line matches your search.

wordQuizNotEnough.message: Save at least $1 lines in the language you're learning for a quiz.

quizzesSubtitle.message: Quizzes made from what you watched and from your word pool. Open one to answer it or look back at it.

quizzesEmpty.message: No quizzes yet. One opens after you watch for a while, and you can make one from your word pool.

quizNotFound.message: This quiz is no longer here.

deckSubtitle.message: The most common English words, most frequent first. Swipe right if you know the word, left if you don't, up if you're not sure.

deckKeysHint.message: ← don't know · ↑ not sure · → know · Space: meaning · Backspace: undo

deckAllSeen.message: You've gone through all the words. Review the ones you didn't know.

deckReviewEmpty.message: Nothing to review. Words you swipe left or up land here.

deckNoKey.message: Add an API key to see meanings and examples:

deckNotEnglish.message: This deck is for English, and you're learning $1 now. Meanings are still written in your language.
